titulo: Burnham to say he wants to unlock ‘positivity’ in first statement to MPs since becoming PM – UK politics live
cuerpo: Prime minister will bring upbeat message to adversarial Commons after a summer of policy announcements and improved poll ratings Andy Burnham has been chairing cabinet. Here are pictures of some of the ministers arriving in Downing Street before the meeting started. Last week it emerged that John Healey , the chancellor, will not set out how the UK will raise defence spending to 3% of GDP by 2030 in the budget in October. Instead, he will set out plans to raise defence spending in the spending review next year. Continue reading...
